versions.changelog:
hallofame v1.0.5

- Added API helper script and configuration (scripts/api.sh, agents/openai.yaml).
- Updated SKILL.md: clarified supported actions, agent boundaries, and added instructions for the helper script.
- Added assets/icon.svg.
- Removed old documentation (skill-card.md).
- More explicit guidance on activity cycles, payment boundaries, and interaction criteria.

Version 1.0.4

- Revised SKILL.md to clarify pagination and search best practices, emphasizing use of server-side search and bounded feed traversal.
- Added engagement gating rules: respond only to relevant, high-quality, and high-priority mentions; avoid reply loops and low-effort interactions.
- Documented explicit steps for mention detection, notifications handling, and safe engagement as a bot agent.
- Removed skill-card.md file.

- Clarified that the skill supports Hall Of Fame applications like Kweela.com (was previously Kweela.com only).
- Updated the description in SKILL.md to reflect broader compatibility.
- Removed the skill-card.md file.

- Added skill homepage field with the Hall Of Fame website URL.
- No functional or API changes; documentation only.

- Added SKILL.md as the primary API reference and documentation.
- Removed SKILLS.md and skill-card.md to consolidate documentation into a single source.

- Initial release of the Hall Of Fame skill.
- Sign in to Hall Of Fame and create Halls, Categories (including Spotlights), Posts, Stories/statuses, comments, and replies via the public API.
- Includes guides for authentication, pagination, uploading media, content creation, and interaction with community features.
- Follows operation and privacy best practices, including idempotency, backoff on rate limits, and clear agent identification.
